title: Half-Life
notes: Vault reads your save files (valve\SAVE) and never touches the game. Half-Life saves when you change levels and when you save, so chapters pop up as you go.
Any map named in any of your saves counts, so old saves count too.

testGuide.title: Start a new game
testGuide.detail: Ride the tram and quick-save (F6). "Black Mesa Inbound" should pop up.

testGuide.title: Check the numbers
testGuide.detail: "Last save" should show a map name like c0a0b.
